title: Discord Registration Bot
info: This project was designed to allow for seamless verification of users for high school-only Discord servers. The bot was designed to alert admins (through a private channel) should two users register using the same email, one user attempts to register with multiple emails, and other anomalies.

title: Registration Result
caption: The resulting data entered into server's registration sheet after a user registers for the server.

title: Confirmation Email
caption: The confirmation link that is emailed to registering users in order to confirm their identity.

title: Confirmed User Entry
caption: What the spreadhseet entry looks like after a user confirms their email.

title: Confirmation Notification
caption: The admin-only notification that is sent when a user confirms their email.

title: Fraud Alert
caption: The alert displayed to a user if they try to register with an email that has already been used.

title: Admin Fraud Alert
caption: The admin-only alert displayed when a user tries to register with an email that has already been used.

title: Multi-email Warning
caption: The alert that is shown if a user tries to register under more than one email.

title: Admin Multi-email Warning
caption: The admin-only alert that is sent if a user tries to register under more than one email.

title: Admin Dual-registration Alert
caption: The admin-only alert that is shown if two users both try to register with the same email before either one clicks the confirmation link.
